biggest_catch: Official company terms confirming shopper pay amounts and payout timing could not be found on Market Force's own site.
catches: Market Force's official site confirms the company is legitimate and warns against fee-charging impersonators, but publishes no shopper pay schedule.
All pay/timing figures (20th-of-month, $5-35 fees) come from third-party reviews and job boards, not company terms.
Cannot verify a concrete payout under the official-terms-only rule.

c1.evidence: Market Force is a real, large mystery shopping company (BBB A+); official site warns shoppers never to pay fees.

c2.evidence: No official pay amounts or payout timing found on marketforce.com; figures cited previously are third-party.

c3.evidence: No official published payout timing; monthly 20th claims are third-party.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee documented in official materials.

notes: Rejected under official-company-terms-only rule: legitimacy confirmed, but neither shopper pay nor payout timing is verifiable from Market Force's own published terms. May be re-verified if official terms surface. This is a weak-evidence rejection, not a scam finding — scam impersonation using the Market Force name remains the user-facing risk.
